descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position IT Project Manager - Pharma R&D Exp- 3 to 6 yers Location- Pune Job description The Delivery Management Professional independently manages less complex deliveries, solves problems within their scope, builds stakeholder relationships, and begins to align their work with broader objectives while supporting team development. In this role, you will take ownership of clearly defined tasks, smaller projects, or initiatives, and contribute to larger project scopes. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service Coordinator, or Scrum Master. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience working within Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, or Pharmacovigilance / Safety team with a solid understanding on the E2E process flow across R&D. Additionally, a proven track record of navigating the stringent requirements of GxP environments (GCP, GMP, GVP) and managing complex, cross-functional data workflows is highly desirable. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert guidance and strategic direction on defining and managing scope for complex or high-impact initiatives. Develops, implements, and champions scope management strategies, frameworks, and best practices for relevant initiatives. Oversees the management of significant scope changes, ensuring strategic alignment and minimal disruption, while proactively identifying and driving improvements to scope-related processes for enhanced delivery efficiency.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies key stakeholders, including senior management, across organizational boundaries and analyzes complex stakeholder networks. Develops and executes comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Influences stakeholder decisions related to delivery, navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and builds strong collaborative relationships across the organization.
• Impact/Strategy: Provides consistent leadership and significant impact across major products within a product line or domain. Drives significant impact on projects and programs by embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, fosters a culture of innovation, and proactively proposes improvements to help implement strategic objectives.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex projects or services, potentially across domains, and leads delivery within a program or large initiative. Manages highly complex delivery involving multiple dependencies, opportunities, and risks. Handles ambiguous delivery requirements and leads the implementation of delivery frameworks while navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
• Strategic Facilitation: Acts as an essential catalyst between business stakeholders, Product Owners, and technical implementation teams. Facilitates alignment across cross-functional squads to ensure digital capabilities are delivered efficiently and translate into measurable business value.
• Agile Delivery Enablement: Empowers the team to seamlessly translate complex business requirements into refined, actionable user stories and sprint increments, removing systemic blockers to accelerate the delivery of digital capabilities.
• GxP Compliance & Quality Governance: Partners with the team to ensure Agile processes, definition of done (DoD), and delivery lifecycles inherently adhere to strict global regu
